text:
inc-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT: Elevated tail latency + enqueue drops for tenant Cassia Health (dedicated pool eu-west-1-ded-2). p99 > 2s for ~7m, enqueue_drop_rate ~18%. Auto-throttle attempted but queue continues to pile. Paging eng-oncall.

maya: saw the alert, paging @alex (oncall) and @jamie. Cassia on Dedicated, heavy short-chat load right now. Customer is on enterprise contract — high-impact.

alex: I'm awake, looking. Any quick customer impact numbers?

maya: from dashboard: 5xx spikes at 21:11, tail latency up. Token throughput steady but a lot of tiny requests causing oversized batches and queue pressure. Also seeing KV-cache evictions logged for that tenant.

jamie: logs from runtime: 
```
[2026-03-14T21:12:02Z] tenant=cassia pool=eu-west-1-ded-2 enqueue_drop count=172
[2026-03-14T21:12:03Z] Scheduler: max_batch_tokens=2048 current_queue=980 avg_wait_ms=420
[2026-03-14T21:12:05Z] runtime: kv_cache_evictions=48 tenant=cassia
[2026-03-14T21:12:07Z] inference: tail_latency_p99=2400ms
```

suresh: suspects that the tenant-specific scheduler knobs are tuned for throughput (big max_batch_tokens) which is hurting latency under bursty small-request workloads. Maybe reduce `max_batch_tokens` and tune coalesce_delay.

alex: agree. We should apply a short-lived override for the tenant to pace them. I'm going to push a mitigation: reduce `max_batch_tokens` and enable small-coalesce for this tenant. Will do quick rollback plan too.

maya: thumbs up. Customer ops notified earlier via account rep. Keep them updated.

alex: running command now (running from admin-shell):
```
# preview
rictl tenant get-config cassia | jq '.scheduler | {max_batch_tokens, coalesce_delay_ms, burst_window_ms}'
# apply mitigation
rictl tenant update-config cassia --set scheduler.max_batch_tokens=512 \
  --set scheduler.coalesce_delay_ms=5 --set scheduler.burst_window_ms=50 --dry-run=false
```

ops-bot: deploy job started: tenant-config-update/cassia/3512346789 -> ok (controller-12).

alex: change applied. watching metrics.

jamie: telemetry shows immediate effect on queue length: current_queue down from ~980 -> ~160 in ~45s. p99 trending down.

maya: customer still has some in-flight requests but error rate dropping. :thumbsup:

alex: also toggled a temporary per-tenant prefix-cache TTL bump to reduce KV cache churn for Cassia while we stabilize. Command: `rictl tenant update-config cassia --set cache.kv_ttl_ms=300000`

rachel: running a synthetic smoke load (small tokens, high qps) against the tenant to validate: 
```
loadgen --qps 200 --payload small-chat --target tenant=cassia --duration 60s
```

jamie: results: p99 dropped to ~650ms, enqueue_drop_rate <1%. Error rate normalized.

alex: great. I'm going to leave these overrides in place for now and create a follow-up runbook to craft a permanent knob profile for Cassia: reduce default max_batch_tokens for short-request tenants and add an automatic pacing policy if enqueue_drop_rate > 5%.

maya: passing the incident to @suresh for post-incident cleanup and long-term fixes. I'm signing off from active paging in 15.

suresh: taking it. Will: 1) document changes to tenant config in infra-as-code, 2) add a retention test for small-request patterns, 3) propose scheduler heuristic to lower max_batch_tokens automatically for tenants with median token/token-per-request < X.

inc-bot: NOTE: incident severity reduced to S3 (customer impact contained). Pager cleared for alex and maya.

rachel: creating a ticket: INF-9872 (Cassia — tenant pacing profile + scheduler heuristic). Assigning to eng-runtime (suresh, jamie).

suresh: also want to add a canary step in Dedicated that triggers a transient tenant-specific cap if queue growth rate > threshold to avoid manual intervention next time.

alex: agreed. Add an ops-check to notify account when we apply tenant overrides. We should keep transparency.

maya: customer rep confirmed they saw degraded service but now stable. They asked for a short postmortem and non-prod knob recommendations.

suresh: I'll draft a brief postmortem and recommended default profiles (small-chat, long-form, embeddings). Will include suggested knobs: `max_batch_tokens: 512` for small-chat, `coalesce_delay_ms: 3-10` depending on latency SLO, `burst_window_ms: 30-100` and an automatic fallback when enqueue_drop_rate spikes.

alex: thanks team. Leaving notes in incident channel and runbook. If anyone wants the exact CLI commands or telemetry slices I can paste them.

maya: :white_check_mark: closing active paging.

inc-bot: incident thread archived. Follow-up ticket INF-9872 opened.
